**Juan Hernández Guizar** is an aerospace systems engineer at **[Blue Origin](https://www.blueorigin.com/)** leading digital twin and model-based systems engineering initiatives for advanced space programs. He combines systems modeling and digital transformation with a focus on technical excellence. Inclusive leadership and community-building are central to his approach.
